## Summary

Educator and cybersecurity practitioner with a Doctor of Education, Certified Master Instructor credential, and 3,000+ hours of classroom instruction in cybersecurity, communications, and aviation systems. Holds CISSP, GXPN, and OSCP certifications and a TS/SCI clearance, with 25+ years of operational experience in cyber and aviation systems.
